record.hypothesis: Question. Can selected H.264/AAC from a two-program transport stream be packaged directly into fragmented MP4 instead of first producing an ordinary MP4? This extends R65's construction rather than introducing a new player route. The six-second fixture contains red H.264 video plus a 440 Hz AAC signal in program 100, with unrelated blue video and 880 Hz AC-3 in program 200. The candidate selects program 100, applies aac_adtstoasc and uses delay_moov with fragmentation. The negative control removes delay_moov from that CLI construction. FFmpeg documents that this flag postpones the initial movie header until the first fragment cut or flush; it does not promise faster first-frame presentation. [F1]
